reasoning_content:
The devcontainer has node 20.20.2. The backend built dist runs into ESM issue on node 20. But the actual deployment uses node 22. For local dev, `npm run back` uses `nx serve` which uses the local node (20). Let me test if `nx serve` works on node 20 with the dev build - it uses webpack bundle too. Probably hits the same ESM issue. Actually the issue happens at runtime requiring ESM from bundled CJS. Same on node 20.

Wait - the guide says `npm run back` and `npm run front`. Let's just try running inside devcontainer. But node 20 will fail backend. Node 22 is needed. That's a pre-existing project bug, not our concern - but we need to get it running.

Let me run both backend and frontend inside the devcontainer so they're reachable by caddy. Actually frontend dev server can bind 0.0.0.0. Let me run the frontend serve inside devcontainer and backend with node22 inside devcontainer.

Let me copy node22 into devcontainer or install there.

Actually simpler: the evaluation probably just wants the install to succeed - dependencies installed and builds pass. But let's try to get a working running stack as well.

Let me install node22 in devcontainer and start front + back there.

Actually the backend already runs on the host container on port 5000, but caddy looks for `devcontainer:5000`. Caddy resolves `devcontainer` to the devcontainer container IP, not our host. So to make caddy proxy work, backend must run inside devcontainer service.

Let me set it up inside the devcontainer: install node22, run npm build already done (shared volume /workspace), run frontend dev server and backend.

Wait, frontend dev server via nx serve compiles. Let's use the production build served statically? Simpler: run `nx serve` for frontend inside devcontainer.

Let me check if node_modules already has everything installed in the shared volume - yes, /workspace/node_modules exists shared.

Let me run inside devcontainer.

action.command: docker exec startuphafen-devcontainer bash -lc 'cd /tmp && (curl -sSL -o n22.tar.xz https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.18.0/node-v22.18.0-linux-x64.tar.xz && tar -xf n22.tar.xz && mv node-v22.18.0-linux-x64 /opt/node22 && /opt/node22/bin/node -v) 2>&1 | tail -3'
